timecoded_text_to_speech.text: The Best Lines
Wesley and I went with the Black Peaces against ML at a very crucial stage in the tournament.
Tell us a little about the game.
Well, it's always good to win with the Black Peaces. Obviously any game is good.
And, you know, the beginning of the game I was kind of happy because I apparently believe he prematurely attacked me.
But then...
Yes.
But then it turned out to be not so bad and I made a mistake.
And then he had two winning moves, but he missed.
And then he also missed a draw and finally I won.
Right, but like just giving up this H4 pawn, I just didn't see him enough compensation at any point.
Yeah, but apparently it's not so easy because he takes control of the C file.
But he played too quickly with the knight and he had...
Again, he had one very easy move to push the pawns and then I would be in big trouble.

What is your feeling going into this final stage of the tournament?
I'm very happy.
